scenario: The ego vehicle travels on a snowy rural road and collides with an adversarial car that drifts into its lane while overtaking another vehicle.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward along its lane on a snowy road and maintains course until impact.

adversarials.behavior: The car overtakes a slower vehicle ahead and drifts leftward into the ego's lane, causing a head-on collision.
The car travels slowly ahead in the same direction as the ego vehicle and is being overtaken by the other adversarial car.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle is on a narrow two-lane snowy rural road with bare trees and buildings on both sides. An adversarial car is ahead in the same lane moving slowly, and a second adversarial car is behind it in the opposing lane overtaking.
requirements_and_restrictions: The scenario terminates upon collision between the ego vehicle and the overtaking adversarial car.

road_side_structures.position: Near the buildings on the right side of the road.

reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: Ego is the dashcam vehicle; two non-ego cars are adversarials. 2. Enumeration: adversarials length is 2. 3. Chronology: initially ego approaches two cars ahead; midpoint overtaking car drifts left into ego lane; ending head-on collision occurs. 4. Evidence: overtaking car's lateral position shifts from opposing lane into ego lane; slow car remains ahead in same lane throughout.
